Rebuilt this session from a single row of five links into four labelled columns (See it work / Understand it / Reference / Project) defined as a `columns` array in frontmatter, because most of the site's pages were reachable only from the nav dropdown. The `variant` prop ('home'|'docs'|'blog'|'how'|'live') still keys directly into a `taglines` object literal, so widening the union alone is NOT enough - a variant with no matching taglines key silently renders an undefined tagline. The column link groups are plain divs, NOT <nav>: landing.css's global nav rule is unscoped and boxes and sticky-positions anything matching it.
